connector.name: Vitex - AI Resume Generator
connector.registryDescription: Generate tailored, ATS-optimized resume PDFs and cover letters from a job description, over MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at vitex.org.nz over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package vitex-cli. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chanmeng666 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
